hotPathPolicy.readOnlyResolvability: Broad mutable TryResolveViews and TryResolveSynthViews helpers were deleted. Cold readiness checks now use TryReadOnlyHandle and minimum-length validation.
hotPathPolicy.dynamicMusicVaultLocking: Dynamic music audio-copy locks the ready output buffer. Scheduled granular jobs lock voices, scalar, tuning, biquad, grain bank, telemetry ring, telemetry cursor, shared state, and target output buffer with same-vault release in finally. Publish resolves only through _synthJobLockedVault and requires the publish lock bitset before writing telemetry/shared state; no NativeArray or raw pointer is stored as a persistent field. Editor read accessors no longer flush or finalize jobs, and biquad low-pass state now finite-sanitizes z1/z2/output.
